expected_behavior: The same missing-docstring defect in nine changed files is one finding (first location, the rest listed in the message), not nine
Eight style nits yield five individually listed nits plus one 'N further style nits' finding
Lint errors in files the change did not touch are not reported; a linter message inside a changed hunk is used only as corroboration
Every blocker and major finding has non-empty evidence quoted from the hunk; findings phrased only as 'might' or 'consider' are dropped
